messages:
mona: Heads-up — noticed a container provenance failure on the staging canary nodes this morning. images failed attestation against the signing service. :eyes:
raj: What exactly failed? paste the error if you have it.
mona: Error from attest-job:
```
attest: signature verification failed: signer error=keystore_access_denied key_id=projects/redwood/keystore/keys/signer-ephemeral
```
mona: Looks like RBAC to the keystore was revoked for the image-signer service account after yesterday's IAM clean-up. tagging @jen_w in case that rings a bell.
jen_w: I did a small role pruning yesterday to remove unused bindings. Which SA lost access?
mona: `k8s serviceaccount:ci:image-signer` — binding to `keystore.reader` is missing. We saw access-denied at 14:13Z, attestation started at 14:14Z.
samira: We need audit logs to prove the change and timeline for compliance — @deploy-bot can you fetch the keystore/audit entries around 14:00-14:30Z?
deploy-bot: fetching keystore audit entries for 2024-06-05T14:00Z - 2024-06-05T14:30Z...
deploy-bot: results:
- 2024-06-05T14:12:07Z rolebinding.update by jen_w repo=infra-iam change=removed binding(ci:image-signer -> keystore.reader)
- 2024-06-05T14:13:18Z keystore.access DENIED subject=ci:image-signer operation=decrypt resource=keys/signer-ephemeral
- 2024-06-05T14:15:02Z attest-job FAILED image=staging-canary-42
raj: Ok — concrete next steps: restore the rolebinding, re-run the attestation, and verify signatures. If rebinds still fail, we may need to rotate the ephemeral signer key and re-sign the canary images. Also check the CI token path — it should use short-lived tokens.
mona: Agreed. Also proposing a canary rebuild checklist so we avoid hitting prod-signer in mass:
- rebind SA -> `kubectl create rolebinding canary-keystore --clusterrole=keystore-reader --serviceaccount=ci:image-signer -n cicd`
- rerun `./attest.sh --image staging-canary-42`
- run vuln-scan (`trivy`), SBOM generation, and store attest artifact
- promote or rollback
jen_w: I'm rolling back the IAM prune now (will re-add the binding). I'll also add an alert on rolebinding deletions to the audit pipeline so this doesn't silently slip by again. ETA 20m.
samira: For compliance/audit trail, we should snapshot the attestation chain and keystore audit to immutable storage (S3 w/lock) and link to the incident doc. Also assign owners: mona=triage, jen_w=IAM rollback + alerts, raj=canary rollout.
mona: ACK. I'll open an incident doc and create the checklist there. quick ops checklist in the doc: 1) rebind SA, 2) rerun attest job, 3) run vuln scan, 4) promote canary or fallback to previously-signed image.
raj: :thumbsup: If signature mismatch persists after rebind, fallback to `sha256:old-signed-image` and halt rollout. Also consider adding a preflight that validates keystore permissions before batch canary builds.
deploy-bot: Incident created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2024-0543 assigned=[mona,jen_w,raj] pagerduty=notified
jen_w: Rolled back binding and re-triggered attest. I'll update once the attest job completes.
mona: Thanks — once attest passes, we'll run a short vulnerability re-scan and then promote canary. If anything flaps, we'll keep rollbacks fast and ensure KMS key rotations are tracked in the incident.
raj: Also follow-up item: add a post-mortem to capture why role pruning lacked a guardrail; propose a deploy-gate that checks active SA usage.
samira: Agreed. Filing follow-up tasks in the incident doc.
jen_w: attest job showed PASS at 2024-06-05T14:37Z. re-run vuln-scan in progress.
mona: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the incident with artifacts and close when promotion is successful.
